The credential opens doors to senior roles and positions you as a credible leader in industries where methodological rigor directly impacts revenue and risk.

Granite PM Academy is a PMI Authorized Training Partner offering live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training designed to fit the schedules of working professionals across the San Francisco Bay Area and beyond. You'll learn the PMBOK® Guide framework, practice exam-style questions, and build confidence in the domains tested on the PMP® exam—all without leaving your office or home. Upon completion, you'll be ready to sit for your certification and take the next step in your project management career.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in San Francisco

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's education and experience requirements—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented hours leading projects—to confirm you meet the credential's standards before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Our nationwide classes run on flexible schedules designed for working professionals. You'll earn all required contact hours through interactive, real-time instruction with active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, file your PMP® application with PMI and pay the associated exam fee. PMI will verify your credentials and experience. Granite PM Academy's team can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation support and practice materials to help you succeed. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center convenient to you. Our instructors remain available to address final questions before you sit.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, training, and service. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education resources to support your renewal cycle.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
